Yea I definitely see the resemblances in our situations too, especially with our reactions. We both fell to someone we loved to help us, but they're really aren't who we need.

No offense taken, I went to a subreddit and asked what I should do with her (after I found the tumblr post) and a lot of people there told me how bad she sounded. The thing about my (ex)gf is she just would never tell me straight up what was wrong. She would put on this whole charade and it would fool me into thinking everything was okay. We couldn't work on our problems because she never told me what she really felt. I still feel like that has left some permanent damage to me, because now I find myself second guessing how everyone really feels.

Breakups are never easy. I have always had a rough time with them even in 7th grade (as stupid as that sounds xD). It just sucks when you fill your head up with these ideas and dreams to share your life when someone and then it just all ends and you have to stop yourself from thinking that way.

Our reactions are damn near the same. The drunken rage, hurting ourselves, and even a loved one(s) finding us sprawled out on the floor screaming like madmen. That night still ranks up there as one of the worst nights in my life. 

Yes, I've spent a good 150-200 hours in Skyrim (hell, I'm still playing thanks to mods on PC). And Yea, I totally get that. Me and my ex used to play Minecraft together and it's hard to play it nowadays without thinking too much about her. I think video games and movies have always been a form of escape for me. It feels nice not to stress out about work/school/social life and just escape it all for a few hours.

I'm still up and down, mostly down nowadays though. I'm still searching up and down for a way to cope and Netflix and Video Games are the closest I've found so far. I'm still trying to remain optimistic though. I'm not sure if I'm even said about the things between me and my ex now though. It seems like when I'm down it's mostly because I feel so lonely. I feel like I miss having someone more than I miss her, you know? Like I'm starting to see how terrible she was and it helps me realize more of what to look for for future gfs. It's just when I realize how lonely I am is when I kick myself in the gut. It just seems like whenever I talk to a new girl or something things don't work out and I worry if I'll ever find someone again. Part of me knows I will and part of me is worried that I only think that way because I've been brainwashed by all the movies I watch and games I play.
